entry_points.text: Termination handles exiting victims by reserve and deferred reclaim, otherwise announces under rate control, fatally signals victim and unrelated sharers, schedules deferred reclaim when allowed. Panic gate halts by setting/scope/origin after header.

exports.text: Per-node counter query returns unsigned count for a selector, with pages variant reading atomic store, clamping negatives and flagging byte items.

Cache summary gives active/total counts, density and order with partial free estimate; swap and unreclaimable reporters have empty/emitting forms, emitting under nonblocking guard while skipping accounted or empty caches.

Sharing checks threads; group resolution is default-only, root default, highest marked with reference; reporter gives usage/limits/failures with path under OOM lock; charging maps space or task with disabled handling.

Drain scans online processors flushing cached charges under a root with nonblocking mutex and migration disabled; over-high abandons dying tasks, reclaims ancestors, clamps delays, retries and sleeps throttled until fatal signal.

Group reclaim frees requested pages with flags/options/swappiness on local zonelist at default priority with cluster floor, write/unmap allowed; node shrink gates swap by flag; soft scans overage groups. Invocation installs task state with tracing, suppresses nesting, clears; shrink expects state.
Walker enumerates descendants with shared coordination and reference handover; pressure helper ignores above-critical priorities, forwarding critical signal otherwise.

hazards.text: Draining outside task context is a programming error.
Reaper uses atomic queued marker against duplicates. Fatal signal precedes reserve grant to avoid depletion.
Task state misuse only warns while still acting, requiring balanced install/remove. Shared walkers race on position with retry, restart when joining at end, early exit on stale generation.

invariants.text: Minimal for unkillable, missing space, minimal tuning, reaping skip, vfork; others sum resident/swap/pagetable plus tuning per thousand. Evaluation keeps highest eligible honouring reserve/origin. Release needs space, no skip/dump, exit progress, sharers agreeing.

Header gives identity/mask/order/tuning, warns without compaction, picks group/global views. Tasks use group scanner or RCU walk, skipping ineligible. Slab detail needs unreclaimable above totals. Global gives free detail and totals; free filters by mask/ceiling; skip inactive without flag.

Dispatch picks default/legacy, warns on overflow. Both flush then emit states/events with combined slab and scan/steal totals and limits. Readers translate indices, warn on unknown, clamp negatives. Flush noop when disabled, null is root; protected silent when disabled/legacy.
Consume needs batch fit, matching group and enough pages, clearing emptied slots with reference release; flush needed when cached group descends from drain root with nonzero pages.

Group/global by target; root when absent or root. Task state single-owned with misuse diagnostics. Zone pass visits each node once, widens mask then restores. Vector drains budgets in batches, halts smaller of anon/file and rebalances.
Excess is usage minus limit or zero. Overage groups order in tree keyed by excess with rightmost largest cache, duplicate guard and cache fixup on removal.

locks.text: Lookup holds RCU while walking threads, returning holding one thread lock when address space present, otherwise releasing each probed lock.
Per-order snapshot takes each zone lock with interrupts saved, copying counts then releasing before emit. Global drain uses nonblocking mutex to avoid duplicates and disables migration across scan.

Stock draining holds local lock, acquiring atomic flag and clearing after full drain. Tree insert/remove/selection hold irq-saving lock except best-effort emptiness test. Walker holds read section with atomic generation/position.

state_machines.text: Scan continues with null/referenced best or aborts releasing prior and marking invalid. Victim goes selection, early exit with deferred reclaim, fatal signalling with reserve, peer signalling and optional deferred reclaim; pinned init forces skip.

Core descends priority scanning zones until goal or compaction readiness, snapshots faults and clears congestion, then retries full walk, forced deactivation and low-reserve inclusion before failing, with distinct success and compaction-abort returns.

structs.text: Shared walker has per-root per-node iterator with generation/position plus per-walker cookie with node/joined generation. Targeted walk accumulates victims until excess clears, two empty passes, quarter progress or bound.
Letters U/M/E/H encode unmovable/movable/reclaimable/high-atomic, with C/I for contiguous/isolated when enabled. Cluster sets minimum request; defaults set start priority and full zone cover.
